help.top:
Usage: dohc <command> <verb> [arguments] [options]

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.

Commands:
  access       Read observed object grants and Sharing inventories.
               object, sharing
  document     Read, edit, and create live Markdown documents, and comment on
               tracked text files.
               read, edit, create, comment
  chat         Read and post in Groups and threads.
               groups, threads, inbox, show, post, reply, react, grep, export
  dataset      Create, change, and use transactional Collections.
               list, describe, history, historyRevision, prepareHistoryRestore,
               permissions, setGrant, removeGrant, lifecycle, archive, restore,
               deletePreview, delete, pendingAttempts, reconcileAttempt,
               cancelAttempt, export, prepareRecovery, claimRecovery,
               discardRecovery, upload, file, createForm,
               prepareRelationChoices, create, prepare, approve, discard,
               prepareMigration, migrationPreviewPage, prepareSchemaChange,
               approveMigration, discardMigration, invoke
  app          Approve, open, and share apps.
               createLink, listLocal, prepareLocal, launchLocal, list, prepare,
               approve, cancel, withdraw, revokeCollection, reviewReactivation,
               responses, undo-responses
  history      Read the changes History records for files.
               list, show
  automation   Press Button fields, read an automation's runs, and try a failed
               run again.
               list, switch, buttons, runs, run, retry, press
  account      Review and delete the server account the dohc app is connected
               to.
               deletePreview, delete

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.

Run dohc <command> --help to see what each verb does.
help.account:
Usage: dohc account <verb> [arguments] [options]

Review and delete the server account the dohc app is connected to.

Verbs:
  deletePreview   List what deleting the connected server account removes.
  delete          Delete the connected server account and the workspaces it owns
                  on the server.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Unlike other commands, account verbs also work outside a workspace folder.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.

Run dohc account <verb> --help to see its arguments and options.
help.account deletePreview:
Usage: dohc account deletePreview [options]

List what deleting the connected server account removes.

The result holds the server and previewToken that delete needs. The token
expires after five minutes.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Unlike other commands, account verbs also work outside a workspace folder.

Options:
  --as-agent   Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json       Print the result as JSON.
  --help       Show help. -h does the same.
help.account delete:
Usage: dohc account delete [options]

Delete the connected server account and the workspaces it owns on the server.

dohc reads the account password from stdin, or asks for it when stdin is a
terminal. Never pass it as an argument.
This cannot be undone. Copies on this computer stay. People you shared with lose
access and keep their copies.
If you create an account again later, the server will not accept your old copies
of the deleted workspaces. Its backups keep the data until they expire.
When the server cannot finish at once, the account stays blocked and the server
finishes later. Either way, the dohc app disconnects from the server.
If the preview expired or changed, run deletePreview again.

Run dohc inside a workspace folder while the dohc app is open.
Unlike other commands, account verbs also work outside a workspace folder.

Options:
  --server <address>        Use server from deletePreview. Required.
  --preview-token <token>   Use previewToken from deletePreview. Required.
  --as-agent                Post and read chat as an agent.
  --json                    Print the result as JSON.
  --help                    Show help. -h does the same.
